attributes.action: Add Environmental Lessons to part of the PSHE curriculum
attributes.background:
We would want to add environmental enrichment onto the PSHE lesson plans within school. 
Note: This is for marketing purposes only

rejection.details:
We don't really know what you are talking about with reference to your note about marketing purposes.

Additionally, we don't know what you mean by environmental enrichment, and environmental matters are already included in parts of the national curriculum.
